name: E Ink Holdings Inc.
summary: E Ink Holdings Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells electronic paper display panels worldwide. It offers high-resolution modules for use in eReaders, electronic shelf labels, eNotes, smart display cards, ePaper mobile devices, luggage and logistic tags, mobile device, IoT, digital signage applications. The company also provides segmented displays for use in consumer electronics, watches, medical devices, industrial gauges, PC accessories, smart cards, electronic shelf labels, and mobile devices; electronic ink films; and flexible substrate material, and polyimide and functional material films.
